Water entered the basement and the pump switch is downstairs. If I wear rubber slippers, can I go switch it off quickly?

Do not enter a flooded basement to reach an electrical switch. Rubber slippers are not reliable protection in standing water.

Keep people away from the basement, stop others from touching wet walls, wires, pumps, or metal railings, and switch power off only from a dry, safe main switch if it is reachable without entering water. If anyone was shocked, has burns, chest pain, fainting, confusion, or breathing trouble, get urgent help.

Wait for trained electrical or rescue help for the flooded area.
